text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just when I think Matikanetannhauser
isn't going
to show up to training...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Well, on the way here, I ran smack bang
into a
wall and ended up getting a
bloody nose...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
To make matters worse, it got all over
my
tracksuit, so I figured I should wash it
straight
away... but then I realized I was
all out of laundry
detergent.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Then, while I was looking for detergent, I ended up walking into the door...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Every time something happened, I just
wanted to
yell, "Really?! Now?!"
Anyway, I'm really sorry...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser seems remorseful
about
being late so I let her off with a
gentle warning to
be careful in the
future.
